# Early Childhood Matters

> A global storytelling platform advancing collective thinking on early childhood development, caregiving, and parental wellbeing through curated content, expert conversations, and community engagement.

Early Childhood Matters is a publication and community platform by the Van Leer Foundation that features research-informed stories, journal issues, and collections exploring child development, caregiving practices, parental support systems, and policy advocacy across multiple languages and regions.

## Key Topics

- early childhood development
- caregiving
- parental wellbeing
- child development
- parenthood
- parental support
- traditional midwifery
- policy advocacy
- urban development
- leadership development
- family support systems
- community engagement
- multilingual content
- Van Leer Foundation

## Core Platform

- [Home](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online): Global storytelling platform advancing collective thinking on early childhood development
- [Stories](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/stories): Story library featuring global perspectives on early childhood development and caregiving
- [Collections](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/collections): Curated content collections on child development, parenting, and early years
- [About Us](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/about-early-childhood-matters): Organization overview, mission, values, and publication history

## Featured Collections

- [New to Early Childhood Matters?](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/collection/new-to-early-childhood-matters): Getting started guide with popular articles and featured content for new visitors
- [How caregiving shapes leadership](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/collection/how-caregiving-shapes-leadership): Collection exploring connections between caregiving and leadership development
- [Want to build better cities? Begin with babies.](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/collection/want-to-build-better-cities-begin-with-babies): Collection on urban development and early childhood in city planning
- [What happens when we become a parent](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/collection/what-happens-when-we-become-a-parent): Collection on parental development, brain changes, and motherhood neuroscience

## Journal Issues & Publications

- [Issues Archive](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/issues): Archive of journal issues on early childhood development and parenting
- [Early Childhood Matters 2026](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/issues/early-childhood-matters-2026): 2026 journal issue on parental wellbeing and parenthood in changing world
- [Early Childhood Matters 2025](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/issues/early-childhood-matters-2025): 2025 journal issue on caregiving support and family support systems

## Community & Events

- [Our Community](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/community): Community hub with events, talks, newsletter signup, and global network
- [Community Directory](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/community-directory): Searchable directory of global community members and contributors
- [Upcoming Events](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/events): Calendar of upcoming events, conversation circles, and community gatherings
- [Talks & Recordings](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/talks-recordings): Archive of expert conversations, launch events, and recorded talks

## Featured Articles

- [Traditional midwifery is finally protected by law in Mexico](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/2026/traditional-midwifery-is-finally-protected-by-law-in-mexico): Article on Indigenous midwifery rights and maternal health in Mexico
- [Real-world insights into becoming a parent while working in healthcare](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/2026/real-world-insights-into-becoming-a-parent-while-working-in-healthcare): Article on work-life balance and parental support in healthcare settings
- [A parteiragem tradicional é finalmente protegida por lei no México](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/pt-pt/2026/a-parteiragem-tradicional-e-finalmente-protegida-por-lei-no-mexico): Portuguese translation of article on Indigenous midwifery protection in Mexico

## Optional

- [History of Early Childhood Matters](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/history-of-early-childhood-matters): Publication history and evolution of Early Childhood Matters journal
- [Susana Harp](https://earlychildhoodmatters.online/community/susana-harp): Community member profile of Mexican policy advocate for traditional midwifery
